questions.question: What is the expected major product when Glyceryl tristearate (tristearin) is treated with 3 equivalents NaOH in H2O / heat?
questions.explanation: Treating Glyceryl tristearate (tristearin) with 3 equivalents NaOH in H2O / heat yields Glycerol + 3 Sodium stearate (soap). Rationale: Base-catalyzed hydrolysis of triglyceride ester linkages yields glycerol and fatty acid carboxylate salts.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Glyceryl trioleate (liquid oil) into Glyceryl tristearate (solid fat)?
questions.explanation: To convert Glyceryl trioleate (liquid oil) into Glyceryl tristearate (solid fat), the appropriate reagent is 3 H2 / Ni catalyst (heat, pressure). Rationale: Catalytic reduction of cis-double bonds in unsaturated fatty acids hardens vegetable oil into solid shortening.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Triglyceride is treated with 3 Methanol (CH3OH) / catalytic NaOH?

options.label: B
options.text: Isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP, C5 unit) + CO2 + ADP + Pi

questions.explanation: Treating Triglyceride with 3 Methanol (CH3OH) / catalytic NaOH yields Glycerol + 3 Fatty acid methyl esters (biodiesel). Rationale: Transesterification replaces glycerol with methyl groups, producing low-viscosity fatty acid methyl esters.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Oleic acid (cis-9-octadecenoic acid) into 9,10-Dibromooctadecanoic acid?
questions.explanation: To convert Oleic acid (cis-9-octadecenoic acid) into 9,10-Dibromooctadecanoic acid, the appropriate reagent is Bromine (Br2) in CH2Cl2. Rationale: Electrophilic anti-addition of bromine across the internal double bond yields the vicinal dibromide.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Phosphatidylcholine is treated with Phospholipase A2 enzyme / H2O?
questions.explanation: Treating Phosphatidylcholine with Phospholipase A2 enzyme / H2O yields Lysophosphatidylcholine + Free fatty acid (at sn-2). Rationale: Phospholipase A2 specifically hydrolyzes the ester bond at the sn-2 position of glycerophospholipids.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 3-Hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA (HMG-CoA) into Mevalonic acid + 2 NADP+ + CoA-SH?
questions.explanation: To convert 3-Hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA (HMG-CoA) into Mevalonic acid + 2 NADP+ + CoA-SH, the appropriate reagent is 2 NADPH / HMG-CoA reductase. Rationale: Committed rate-limiting step in cholesterol biosynthesis reducing thioester to primary alcohol.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with ATP / Decarboxylase enzyme to yield Isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP, C5 unit) + CO2 + ADP + Pi as the major product?
questions.explanation: Mevalonate-5-pyrophosphate reacts with ATP / Decarboxylase enzyme to yield Isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP, C5 unit) + CO2 + ADP + Pi. Rationale: Phosphorylation and concerted decarboxylative elimination forms the activated 5-carbon isoprene building block.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Squalene-2,3-epoxide is treated with Oxidosqualene cyclase enzyme?
questions.explanation: Treating Squalene-2,3-epoxide with Oxidosqualene cyclase enzyme yields Lanosterol (tetracyclic steroid core). Rationale: Acid-catalyzed epoxide opening triggers a spectacular four-ring polycyclization cascade and methyl/hydride shifts.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with CrO3 / H2SO4 (Jones reagent) to yield 4-Cholesten-3-one as the major product?
questions.explanation: Cholesterol reacts with CrO3 / H2SO4 (Jones reagent) to yield 4-Cholesten-3-one. Rationale: Oxidation of 3-hydroxy group accompanied by double-bond isomerization to conjugated enone.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Squalene (C30 triterpene, 6 double bonds) is treated with 1. Excess O3; 2. Zn, H2O?

options.label: C
options.text: Isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP, C5 unit) + CO2 + ADP + Pi

questions.explanation: Treating Squalene (C30 triterpene, 6 double bonds) with 1. Excess O3; 2. Zn, H2O yields 2 Acetone + 4 4-Oxopentanal + Succinaldehyde. Rationale: Cleavage of all 6 double bonds in squalene confirms its recurring isoprene repeating structure.
